chunks: Beware lest bearers of greed should carry you,
and make you descend down to the springs of destruction.
If you can manage that there be no wealthy person between yourself and Allāh, do so,
because in any case you will find what is for you and get your share.
A little received directly from Allāh the Glorified, is more dignified than that which is more but is received through (the obligation of) His creatures, although (really) all is from Allāh.

key_terms.ذُو نِعْمَةٍ: A person of favor/wealth, a wealthy person
key_terms.مَنَاهِلَ: Springs or sources of water, metaphorically sources of something

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of relying directly on God versus relying on wealthy intermediaries?
ai.summary: In this instruction to Hasan ibn Ali, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) warns against the 'hasty stride' of greed that leads to ruin, advocating for spiritual self-sufficiency by bypassing wealthy intermediaries to connect directly with the Divine. This reflects the Shia emphasis on *istighna* (independence from creation) and highlights the theological principle that the quality of divine grace outweighs the quantity of worldly provision, a concept rooted in the concept of *karam* (generosity) unique to God.
